title: PREMIER LEAGUE CHAMPIONS KNOCKED OUT BY LEAGUE TWO FLEETWOOD!
description:
He had never practised a penalty. He scored the one that mattered.

Fleetwood drew 1-1 with Arsenal, then won the shootout 5-3. Their winner, 19-year-old Conor Haughey, had never practised a penalty. Imagine if he had.

Jay Lynch saved Bruno Guimaraes' penalty, so Fleetwood had a hero at each end. Max Dowman was sent off in the 85th minute, and Arteta said a drone stopped play for eight minutes.

ESPN says no Premier League champion had lost a League Cup tie to a fourth-tier side before this. The drone did not help.
